notes.title: The Binding of Fortnite!
notes.content:
[h3]The rumors are true! [/h3][h2]The Binding of Isaac is today's Fortnite crossover!![/h2][p]What does that mean???[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3871154/e6a95b5c20e65f876825bb68c34de2951345eb5a.png"][/img]It means Isaac is now Back Bling! He wiggles, cries, and cheers you on as you play![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3871154/94e57950c26d73d9ab68a2369eab6ed45b49faeb.png"][/img]It means you can ride the Duke of Flies![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3871154/438be9b7e1c9e79559ebaf8cc8a98e43a76d5240.png"][/img][/p][p]It means Mom's Knife can do more stabbing (look closely into the knife's reflection and tell me what you see!).[/p][p][/p][p]Overall I'm quite happy with how it all turned out. The team did an amazing job with all these details. But honestly, I gotta hand this one to the fans who screamed Isaac from the mountains so loudly that the Fortnite team took notice and made the "wHen ISaAc iN FOrtnIte!!!!???" meme a reality! [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]In other Isaac news, the Conquest T-shirt went live yesterday! The final shirt in the Horsemen series, Conquest also comes with a limited-edition alt-art promo card for Four Souls![/p][p][url="https://maestromedia.com/products/the-binding-of-isaac-four-souls-conquest-card?variant=50636480479541"]Grab
 it here![/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3871154/b0919c55afde2caad034921c9a01020cc440b492.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]And what would an Isaac update be without a Mewgenics cameo...[/p][h3][b]Check out the 1st gameplay video of Mewgenics![/b] Hosted by yours truly! [/h3][previewyoutube="cAiIiju7lCo;full"][/previewyoutube][p]This 50-min video is part one of a series of let's plays I'll be doing to showcase the depth this little monster features... keep your eyes open for yet another Isaac crossover at the halfway point ;).[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/686060/Mewgenics/"]Wishlist
 it on Steam![/url][/p][p][/p][p]The crazy thing is... there are even more Isaac announcements to come! Stay tuned![/p][p]-Edmund[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Isaac Mega update!
notes.content:
So its been a while since i did any announcements here, but this month is so jam packed with updates i thought id go beyond my updates on [url=https://x.com/edmundmcmillen]twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@edmundmcmillen]tiktok[/url] and do a quick recap here! 


[b][h3]ISAAC NENDOROID! [/h3][/b]
[previewyoutube=G5Vo0lD5R2U;full][/previewyoutube]

im a huge action figurine fan and goodsmile has always been the pinnacle of [url=https://www.goodsmileus.com/product/nendoroid-isaac-14114?utm_source=socials&utm_medium=GSCus&utm_campaign=PREORDER_Nendoroid+Isaac]articulated figurines[/url] ( i have a full collection of overwatch figures by them! ) so as you might assume, turning isaac into a Nendoroid was a HUGE bucket list item for me! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3871154/b76bed34c834a8abf3c24de303d83e3344eb6db9.jpg[/img]
Preorders have started today and those who preorder gain access to 2 limited edition [url=https://maestromedia.com/collections/binding-of-isaac-four-souls]four souls[/url] cards and a really neato backdrop. 

[url=https://www.goodsmileus.com/product/nendoroid-isaac-14114?utm_source=socials&utm_medium=GSCus&utm_campaign=PREORDER_Nendoroid+Isaac]grab your figure here. [/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3871154/104450e71280004333c0351dbe403b9e6f427e3a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3871154/f5c3fc2bedce1cc85c7b5368dd45b398c49546b5.jpg[/img]




[b][h3]ISAAC ONLINE[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3871154/caf31ffdaa853efec8ae29d46612ef889c494e87.jpg[/img]
The binding of isaac Rebirth just turned 10 and to celebrate we have announced that Repentance will be getting a FREE DLC called "isaac online" a dedicated online co-op mode that releases on the 18th! this update will also come with a ton of item balance updates (all buffs!)

Keep in mind this DLC will only be accessible to those who own the full Rebirth DLC collection so if you are missing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/250900/The_Binding_of_Isaac_Rebirth/]Repentance[/url] and want in go grab them while they are on sale this week!




[b][h3]MEWGENICS![/h3][/b]
[previewyoutube=zmTtHcm7z3Y;full][/previewyoutube]
For those of you unaware, I've been working on a new roguelike for the last 6 years called Mewgenics. its a turn based strategy rpg that is hyper focused on replayability, in many ways it feels like an extension of what isaac is so i think there will be a good deal of overlap with isaac fans. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3871154/3f08248ea8567a13b83049ac7087d45bd27b3ce0.jpg[/img]
if this is at all interesting to you, please [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/686060/Mewgenics/]wishlist mewgenics on steam[/url] and check out all our dev blog updates. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/686060/Mewgenics/]wishlisting[/url] really helps us get visibility on release so dont neglect it if you like what you see :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3871154/63c7cc44c6e57d71c61ac1e1c69855e2e2bbd45c.jpg[/img]




[b][h3]MORE ISAAC SWAG![/h3][/b]

xoxo

notes.title: The Binding of Isaac gets free Halloween update, is now 20% more evil
notes.content:
http://youtu.be/5eXUMfVsfTU

The Binding of Isaac was already quite evil. You play as a naked child fleeing for his life through a monster-infested basement to escape his mother, who has been commanded by god to slay Isaac as proof of her faith. Indiegames note that after the free Halloween update, you will be able to fight three new bosses, four new enemies and collect more than 20 new items if you successfully slay your mother ten times. The update also adds a new playable character, another ending, more achievements, more music, tarot cards and MORE EVIL. The Binding of Isaac comes from one half of Team Meat, Edmund McMillen, and is available now on Steam for £3.99 / $4.99.

notes.title: Get 20% More Evil in Today's Free The Binding of Isaac Update
notes.content:
Edmund McMillen's The Binding of Isaac managed to be one of the creepiest, most f-ed up games come out in quite some time. So, it's especially fitting that the co-creator of Super Meat Boy's offering a sizable update on All Hallow's Eve for his action-RPG shooter. Here's what the update adds, from McMillen's blog:

-Added chapter 5 (unlocked after 10 mom kills)
-Added 3+ new bosses
-Added 4 new enemies
-Added 20+ new items
-Added one new unlockable character (Eve)
-Added one new "FINAL" ending.
-Added 6+ new achievements
-Added 2 new music tracks
-Added updated collection viewer
-Added 4 new tarot cards (finishing the major arcana)

McMillen promised that he'd be rolling out fresh Isaac content if the game garnered a sizable following and this update follows up on that pledge. You can get the game over on Steam right here.

The Binding of Isaac Halloween update! [Edmund McMillen]
